isolation: Only the owning family's unchanged report and response are present in its chain. Shared evidence is neutral; the complete source receipt is preserved signed, with only admissionBindings omitted in the derivative.
limits: Readiness only, not semantic or publication acceptance. External extracts and mixed read-chain segments remain local.

memory.peakScope: Verifier Python process, including its monitor thread; not subprocess peaks.
memory.additionalChecks: Before each file and each streamed chunk; signal interruption on a sampled breach.
